choice.basis: The dashboard legend maps pale yellow to the high-incidence end (100) and dark burgundy to the low-incidence end (0). Texas (TX) is filled pale yellow, Washington (WA) is filled dark burgundy, and Colorado (CO) is gray (no data). TX is the only candidate in the high-incidence color band, making it the highest-incidence jurisdiction among the options.
choice.option_label: Open Texas (TX) incidence profile for follow-up routing
